om_id.description: The OM this entry belongs to — temporal spine key

timestamp_ms.description: Unix ms — monotonically increasing per OM

collapse_hash.description: SHA-256 of the OM at this point in time

execution_graph_hash.description: SHA-256 of the execution graph produced at this time

constraint_hash.description: CAR-1 constraint set hash — must be stable across versions

singular_goal_hash.description: SHA-256 of singular_goal — must never change for same om_id

previous_hash.description: Previous FabricTimeChain entry hash — null for first collapse

version.description: Monotonic version counter for this OM

drift_score.description: 0 = identical to prior execution, >0 = drift detected

tci_holds.description: Temporal Coherence Invariant — false if drift_score > 0 on non-superseded OM

lineage_hash.description: Must match OM.lineage_hash — binds temporal chain to causal chain

replay_valid.description: True if this is a replay that produced identical execution graph

superseded_by.description: om_id of successor if this is a supersession event
